from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

def format_invoice_line(year, month, day, amount):
    quarter = (month - 1) // 3 + 1
    date_str = f"{month:02d}/{day:02d}/{year:04d}"

    dec_amount = Decimal(str(amount)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    if dec_amount < 0:
        amount_str = f"({abs(dec_amount):.2f})"
    else:
        amount_str = f"{dec_amount:.2f}"

    return f"Q{quarter} {date_str} {amount_str}"
